NEPUNYA 2026 – CHANGE FOR BUILD HACKATHON

Build for Change | 01_BUILD → 02_CREATE → 03_CHANGE

Organized by: Department of Students Welfare, Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU), Haryana

About the Hackathon

Are you ready to turn your ideas into impactful solutions?

NEPUNYA 2026 – Change for Build Hackathon is an exciting innovation and problem-solving event organized by the Department of Students Welfare, Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU).

The hackathon aims to bring together enthusiastic individuals, creative thinkers, and aspiring innovators to identify real-world challenges and develop practical, technology-driven solutions.

Participants will get an opportunity to demonstrate their creativity, technical knowledge, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities by working on real-world problem statements.

The challenge begins at the venue! Unlike conventional hackathons where problem statements are shared in advance, the problem statements for this event will be announced and provided to participants on the spot at the venue. Participants will then work on developing innovative solutions within the given time.

IMPORTANT – Mandatory Registration Instructions

All participants are required to complete BOTH registration processes to participate in NEPUNYA 2026 – Change For Build Hackathon.

Step 1: Register for the hackathon through Unstop.

Step 2: Fill out the official Google Registration Form using the link below.

Google Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc_yJpqzFxzPk9sKBfrqWNy4h-m4od-yvvZRITVDv4vSLXJLA/viewform

Note: Completing both registrations is mandatory. Only participants who complete both steps will be considered registered for the hackathon.

Event Highlights

  • On-the-spot problem statement announcement.

  • Hands-on innovation and solution development.

  • Opportunity to work on real-world challenges.

  • A platform to showcase creativity and technical skills.

  • Collaboration, learning, and healthy competition.

  • An opportunity to turn ideas into meaningful solutions.

Who Can Participate?

Open to everyone!

There are no specific eligibility restrictions for participation. Anyone interested in innovation, technology, creativity, and problem-solving is welcome to register and participate.

Whether you are a beginner, student, developer, or aspiring innovator, this is your opportunity to challenge yourself and bring your ideas to life.

Event Details

  • Event Name: NEPUNYA 2026 – Change for Build Hackathon

  • Date: 17 November 2026

  • Time: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM

  • Mode: Offline

  • Venue: 102 E1, Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Haryana

  • Organizer: Department of Students Welfare, SVSU

Why Participate?

Don't just think about change — build it!

Participate in NEPUNYA 2026 to challenge your thinking, explore new ideas, develop practical solutions, and experience the excitement of building something meaningful.

Bring your creativity, curiosity, and problem-solving spirit. The problem statements will be revealed at the venue, and your innovation will shape the outcome.

Register now and be a part of NEPUNYA 2026 – Change for Build Hackathon!
